_comment: Copy this file to pandabot.config.json and fill in your real values.
pandabot.config.json is gitignored — it never reaches the repository.
build.sh bakes these into the zip as pandabot/site-config.php.
Any key left empty is skipped entirely and the setting stays editable
in the WordPress admin as normal.
_comment_providers: Base URL and model are safe to bake in. API KEYS ARE NOT: a value here
ends up in a PHP file inside your web root and inside the zip itself,
so anyone you hand the zip to gets your key. Leave them empty and set
keys either in the WordPress admin or as wp-config.php constants —
build.sh warns loudly if you fill one in anyway.
